# AvatarLookup Image Profile Analysis API
> Official integration for public product code image_profile.

- Product: https://avatarlookup.com/products/image_profile
- Documentation: https://avatarlookup.com/api-docs
- API key: https://avatarlookup.com/register?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=avatarlookup_image-profile-analysis-api
- OpenAPI: openapi.yaml
- Base URL: https://avatarlookup.com; authentication: X-API-Key.
- Endpoint: POST /api/v1/image/profile.
- Request service_type: image_profile.
- Result fields directly in data: service_type, identifier, category, age, gender, skin_color, hair_color. No extra/provider/profile_available layer.
- age is an integer omitted when unknown; portrait strings may be unknown or empty.
- Image input: HTTPS URL, base64 or multipart file; no phone/email identifier.
- code=0 is success; 42200 is undetermined and uncharged. Network timeouts are not a reason for blind retries.
- Current pricing: https://avatarlookup.com/pricing.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.
